intro: Ruul Eagletalon is a tauren resident of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Stationed near the settlement's perimeter, he keeps a watchful eye on the local wildlife, particularly the aggressive Windfury harpies encroaching upon tauren lands.

p: Ruul Eagletalon stands guard in Bloodhoof Village, tending to the security of the settlement as young braves arrive from Camp Narache. While Mulgore is a peaceful homeland compared to the arid wastes of the Barrens, territorial predators and hostile creatures continually press against the pastures. Ruul concerns himself with threats roaming the nearby plains, notably directing capable travelers to confront the savage Windfury harpies who prey on unwary nomads and game.
